verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring automations is a fair question for a knowledge-base app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-configurable recurring job or workflow scheduler. The automatic midnight Journals page is a fixed built-in behavior, and date-linked reminders are manual references rather than recurring jobs. The plugin API, local HTTP server and logseq:// protocol are developer building blocks that would need an external scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
